title: Tefnakht
summary: King listed in CFAH-10 Table 7 (Egypt Dynasty 24).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 24. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-10 (Table 7, "CFAH Solution for Dynasty 24"); its dates are display only.
